# OneAlgorithm

> OneAlgorithm is a woman-owned technology and marketing company based in
> Malvern, Pennsylvania (Chester County, Philadelphia metro), working with
> clients across the United States. We build and market websites for small
> businesses — web development, SEO, Google Ads, marketing and CRM. As a listed
> Salesforce Consulting Partner we also deliver Salesforce, systems integration
> and staff augmentation nationally.

## About

- **Company name**: OneAlgorithm LLC (brand: OneAlgorithm Consulting)
- **Headquarters**: 625 Swedesford Rd, Unit B, Malvern, Pennsylvania 19355
- **Phone**: 1 (610) 890-9711
- **Website**: https://onealgorithm.com
- **Contact**: https://onealgorithm.com/contact
- **Certifications**: WBENC Certified WBE; NMSDC Certified MBE; Salesforce Consulting Partner (AppExchange listing a0N3A00000EV7SwUAL). Details: https://onealgorithm.com/capabilities
- **Identifiers**: UEI W8DYK38MEKP3 · CAGE 14G18 · D-U-N-S 118835343

## Services

- [Custom website design and development](https://onealgorithm.com/services/website-development): custom websites designed and built from our Malvern, PA office, with six live client sites shown on the page.
- [How much does a website cost](https://onealgorithm.com/services/website-cost): what sets the price of a custom website, with the scope and price in writing before work starts.
- [Small business website design](https://onealgorithm.com/services/small-business-website-design): websites for owner-led businesses, built to be found, explain the service and take the call, booking or order.
- [Website redesign](https://onealgorithm.com/services/website-redesign): a new design and code on your existing domain, with every old address redirected so rankings carry over.
- [All services](https://onealgorithm.com/services): every service OneAlgorithm sells, with links to each page.
- [SEO services](https://onealgorithm.com/services/seo): SEO and AI-search visibility for small businesses, with the method and a measured case study.
- [Google Ads management](https://onealgorithm.com/services/google-ads): Google Ads management that starts with an audit, with the account kept in the client's name.
- [Marketing and social media](https://onealgorithm.com/services/marketing): social media and marketing management on accounts the client owns.
- [Custom application development](https://onealgorithm.com/services/application-development): portals, internal tools and web applications, with the code and cloud accounts in the client's name from day one.
- [MarTech integration](https://onealgorithm.com/services/martech): marketing technology integration between campaign tools, CRM and analytics.
- [IT consulting](https://onealgorithm.com/services/it-consulting): IT consulting for small and mid-size companies.
- [Staff augmentation](https://onealgorithm.com/services/staff-augmentation): contract engineers, including Salesforce staff augmentation.
- [Zendesk implementation](https://onealgorithm.com/services/zendesk): Zendesk setup and integration with Salesforce.
- [Operational transformation consulting](https://onealgorithm.com/services/operational-transformation-consulting): fix the process first, then the systems: Salesforce, IT and MarTech built around how work runs.
- Salesforce consulting: see the Salesforce section below

## Salesforce

OneAlgorithm is a Select Salesforce Consulting Partner on AppExchange (listing
a0N3A00000EV7SwUAL: 16 Salesforce-certified people, 53 certifications, 38 of
them Platform), working from Malvern, PA. Every page below offers the free
one-week Salesforce health check.

## Industries

- [Industries we serve](https://onealgorithm.com/industries): what we have and have not done in each sector.
- [Construction](https://onealgorithm.com/industries/construction): systems integration, Salesforce, job reporting and web work for construction firms.
- [Manufacturing](https://onealgorithm.com/industries/manufacturing): ERP, data and systems integration for manufacturers; the page states what we have not done on the plant floor.
- [E-commerce](https://onealgorithm.com/industries/ecommerce): WooCommerce and custom e-commerce builds, with integrations to stock, payments, the ledger and Zendesk.
- [Marketing teams](https://onealgorithm.com/industries/marketing): social media on accounts you own, MarTech integration between campaign tools and CRM, and the analytics under it.
- [Government](https://onealgorithm.com/industries/government): eligibility only: SBA WOSB/EDWOSB certification, SAM registration (UEI W8DYK38MEKP3, CAGE 14G18); no contract awarded yet, and we say so.
